_about: Provisional, NON-CLINICAL adjudication of the demo upload set, read from the images in samples/ and the detector overlays in ml/reports/miss_boxes/. Its only purpose is to stop counting a forearm film and a normal hip as femur-fracture misses. A clinician must confirm every value here before any number derived from it is quoted as accuracy.

_fields.in_scope: true = the film shows the femur; false = it does not (excluded from recall); null = this reader could not tell
_fields.fracture: true / false / null (null = indeterminate, excluded until a clinical read)
_fields.site: where the pathology is, so a below-gate candidate can be checked against it
